name: platformer-template
description: Data-driven 1-4 player 2D platformer starter: Next.js (App Router) + Phaser 4 client, authoritative Node.js WebSocket game server, shared TypeScript domain/data package.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,assets -c magenta,cyan,gray "npm run dev -w @platformer/server" "npm run dev -w @platformer/web" "node scripts/sync-assets.mjs --watch"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @platformer/server && npm run build -w @platformer/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @platformer/server" "npm run start -w @platformer/web"
